segments.zh: 各位英语学习者，大家好。

segments.en: And today we're bringing you another great lesson about sports, part of our sports series.
segments.zh: 今天，我们将为您带来关于体育的另一个重要课程，这是我们体育系列的一部分。

segments.en: And in this lesson, we are talking about maybe the world's most favorite sport.
segments.zh: 在本课中，我们谈论的可能是世界上最受欢迎的运动。

segments.en: One of the most popular sports in the world, soccer.
segments.zh: 世界上最受欢迎的运动之一，足球。

segments.en: Or also known as football in other countries.
segments.zh: 或者在其他国家也被称为足球。

segments.en: So, before we get started with this great lesson, let's take a look at some of the words we'll find in the dialogue in Vocabulary Preview.
segments.zh: 所以，在我们开始学习这个伟大的课程之前，让我们来看看我们将在词汇预览的对话中找到的一些单词。

segments.en: We're going to look at three words here.
segments.zh: 我们将在这里看三个词。

segments.en: Now, wingman isn't really related to soccer in any way.
segments.zh: 现在，Wingman 与足球并没有任何关系。

segments.en: But it's a way of referring to somebody as your right hand.
segments.zh: 但这是一种把某人看作你左膀右臂的说法。

segments.en: So a wingman is someone who helps you a lot.
segments.zh: 所以僚机是对你有很大帮助的人。

segments.en: Now, this is an interesting word because tie can be a noun, verb, and an adjective, right?
segments.zh: 现在，这是一个有趣的词，因为 tie 可以是名词、动词和形容词，对吧？

segments.en: So in this case, they are tied.
segments.zh: 所以在这种情况下，他们打平了。

segments.en: Is a game that has ended with no winner or loser.
segments.zh: 是一场没有赢家或输家的游戏。

segments.en: Both of them had the same score.
And so obviously, the verb to tie is to reach the same score as your other team.
segments.zh: 所以很明显，动词 tie 就是和对方球队打成相同的比分。

segments.en: Well, our third word can also be used as a noun and a verb and it is foul.
segments.zh: 好吧，我们的第三个词也可以用作名词和动词，它就是 foul。

segments.en: So, to foul somebody is to do something to them that is not allowed in the sport.
segments.zh: 所以，对某人犯规就是对他们做一些这项运动不允许的事情。

segments.en: And so when you do this, you have committed a foul.
segments.zh: 所以当你这样做时，你就犯了规。

segments.en: So you use it in the same way, to foul or a foul.
segments.zh: 所以你以同样的方式使用它：to foul 或 a foul。

segments.en: Well, we're going to hear these three words in context now.
segments.zh: 好吧，我们现在将在上下文中听到这三个词。

segments.en: So why don't we listen to our soccer dialogue?
segments.zh: 那么我们为什么不听我们的足球对话呢？
我的名字是瑞克菲尔兹。

segments.en: And as always, I am joined by my commentating wingman, Bob Copeland.
segments.zh: 和往常一样，跟我搭档解说的是鲍勃·科普兰。

segments.en: And we're in the brink of soccer history today as Ecuador and Brazil are tied 1-1.
segments.zh: 今天我们正见证历史时刻：厄瓜多尔与巴西暂时一比一平。

segments.en: As we begin the second half of the 2022 World Cup.
The ref calls the players for the kickoff.
segments.zh: 裁判示意双方准备开球。

segments.en: Ecuador quickly passes the ball to the midfield.
segments.zh: 厄瓜多尔迅速将球传给中场。

segments.en: But oh, it's out of bounds.
That'll be a throw in for Brazil.
Adriano has the ball and makes a long pass to Robinho.
segments.zh: 阿德里亚诺拿到球，长传给罗比尼奥。

segments.en: And the ref has called him offside.
He was offside by a mile.
We have a goal kick for Ecuador.
Edison Mendes heads it to Valencia.
segments.zh: 爱迪生·门德斯头球摆渡给巴伦西亚。

segments.en: And we have a corner kick.
Dida, the goalkeeper, has fouled the Ecuadorian player.
segments.zh: 守门员迪达对厄瓜多尔球员犯规。

segments.en: And that will be a penalty kick.
This is the perfect opportunity for Ecuador to get ahead in this match and become world champions.
segments.zh: 这是厄瓜多尔反超比分、夺得世界冠军的绝佳机会。

OK, so Ecuador tied with Brazil in the 2022 World Cup.
segments.zh: 好的，所以厄瓜多尔在 2022 年世界杯上与巴西并列。

segments.en: Wow, Marco, I'm really happy to see that you are able to see so far into the future.
segments.zh: 哇，马可，我真的很高兴看到你能够看到这么远的未来。

segments.en: So in 2022, if we do win the World Cup, you know who said it first.
segments.zh: 所以在 2022 年，如果我们真的赢得了世界杯，你知道谁先说的。

segments.en: Do you have money on that?

segments.zh: 所以除此之外，我们在本课中看到了一些非常棒的词汇。

segments.en: This is how you start a soccer game, right?
segments.zh: 这就是你开始足球比赛的方式，对吧？

segments.en: So in the beginning, the referee blows the whistle and you kick the ball to another player.
segments.zh: 所以一开始，裁判吹哨，你把球踢给另一个球员。

segments.en: So our next phrase, out of bounds.
segments.zh: 所以我们的下一个短语，越界了。

segments.en: So in soccer, when the ball goes out of bounds, it goes outside the white lines, right?
segments.zh: 所以在足球中，当球越界时，它会超出白线，对吧？

segments.en: And you can use it in all other sports.
segments.zh: 您可以在所有其他运动中使用它。

segments.en: You can use it in basketball.
segments.zh: 你可以在篮球中使用它。

segments.en: You can use it in tennis.
segments.zh: 你可以在网球中使用它。

segments.en: So any part that is not for playing.
segments.zh: 所以任何不适合玩的部分。
我们的下一个词是什么？

segments.en: The ball goes out of bounds.
How do you put it back into play?
segments.zh: 你如何让它重新投入使用？

segments.en: So you throw in the ball.
That's the only time where a soccer player will actually grab the ball with his hands.
segments.zh: 那是足球运动员唯一一次真正用手抓球的时候。

segments.en: Now, another soccer term we have here, offside.
segments.zh: 现在，我们这里有另一个足球术语，越位。

segments.en: So this is a little bit difficult to explain.
But just imagine you're on the soccer field.
segments.zh: 但想象一下你在足球场上。

segments.en: And you are trying to score a goal.
Now, you have some defenders, right?
segments.zh: 现在，你有一些防守者，对吧？

segments.en: Those are the people who are trying to take the ball away.
segments.zh: 那些试图把球拿走的人。

segments.en: And you pass the ball to somebody who is behind the defenders.
segments.zh: 你将球传给防守者身后的人。

segments.en: Oh, and that person is offside.
So, you must be at all times in the same position as the defenders or in front of them.
segments.zh: 因此，您必须始终处于与防守者相同的位置或在他们面前的位置。

segments.en: But you can't be all the way in the back.
So is this a noun or a verb or an adjective?
segments.zh: 那么这是名词、动词还是形容词？

segments.en: Now, we're going to look at three different phrases for three types of kicks in soccer.
segments.zh: 现在，我们将看看足球中三种类型的踢球的三个不同的短语。

segments.en: So let's take a look at this.
segments.zh: 所以让我们来看看这个。

segments.en: The first one is goal kick.
So who does the goal kick?
It's usually the goalie or the goalkeeper who takes the goal kick.
segments.zh: 通常是守门员来开球门球。

segments.en: So when the goalie kicks the ball.
Now, what about a corner kick?
So if the team is attacking and the ball goes out of bounds in the back area near the goal, then they get a corner kick.
segments.zh: 因此，如果球队正在进攻并且球在球门附近的后方区域出界，那么他们会得到一个角球。

segments.en: They've got to kick the ball from the corner of the field.
segments.zh: 他们必须从球场的角落踢球。

segments.en: This is a great chance to score a goal, isn't it?
segments.zh: 这是一个进球的好机会，不是吗？

segments.en: And what about a penalty kick?
So if a player gets fouled while he is in the area near the goal, he gets a penalty kick.
segments.zh: 因此，如果一名球员在球门附近的区域被犯规，他将被罚点球。

segments.en: I think it's 13 or 15 steps away from the goalie and he gets the opportunity to score or to kick the ball.
segments.zh: 我认为距离守门员 13 或 15 步之遥，他有机会得分或踢球。

segments.en: So there are no defenders or other players in the way.
segments.zh: 所以没有防守者或其他球员在路上。

segments.en: Another great chance to score a goal.
Well, these are all great soccer words.
segments.zh: 嗯，这些都是很棒的足球词。

segments.en: I think we should hear them again in context.
segments.zh: 我认为我们应该在上下文中再次听到它们。

segments.en: Well, Marco, there are three great phrases in this dialogue that I want to look at.
segments.zh: 好吧，马可，我想看看这个对话中有三个很棒的短语。

segments.en: The first one, on the brink of.
We are on the brink of.
We're on the brink of soccer history.
segments.zh: 我们正处于足球历史的边缘。

segments.en: Well, why don't we hear some examples to help us understand the meaning.
segments.zh: 好吧，我们为什么不听一些例子来帮助我们理解含义。

segments.en: Look, we don't have any money.
We're on the brink of going bankrupt.
segments.zh: 我们正处于破产的边缘。

segments.en: The two countries are on the brink of war.
We're on the brink of an important discovery.
segments.zh: 我们正处于一个重要发现的边缘。

segments.en: So great examples, on the brink of, at a critical point.
segments.zh: 很好的例子：on the brink of，意为处于关键时刻。

segments.en: It means you're almost there, right?
segments.zh: 这意味着你快到了，对吧？

segments.zh: 所以，这是一个没有多大意义的陈述。

segments.en: But what am I saying when I say, oh, no question about it?
segments.zh: 但是当我说，哦，毫无疑问时，我在说什么？
好吧，让我们举一些例子。

segments.en: I could say, there's no question about it.
segments.zh: 我可以说，这是毫无疑问的。

segments.en: Ecuador is a great soccer team.
segments.zh: 厄瓜多尔是一支伟大的足球队。

segments.en: There is no question about that.

segments.zh: 所以，或者你可以说，毫无疑问。

Okay well, as you all may know, soccer is a very popular sport, especially in Latin America.
segments.zh: 好吧，众所周知，足球是一项非常受欢迎的运动，尤其是在拉丁美洲。

segments.en: And your favorite team, Ecuador, are they really this good in soccer?
segments.zh: 你最喜欢的球队厄瓜多尔，他们真的在足球方面这么好吗？

segments.en: Are they really going to win the 2022 Cup?
segments.zh: 他们真的会赢得2022年杯赛吗？

segments.en: Well, actually Ecuador has improved with time, but usually it's the strong teams like Argentina and Brazil who dominate the region, right?
segments.zh: 好吧，实际上厄瓜多尔随着时间的推移有所改善，但通常是像阿根廷和巴西这样强大的球队占据了该地区的主导地位，对吧？
